Algorithm.description: Exact event-selection algorithm. All sample the same law; they differ in cost and random-word use.

Budget.description: Resource limits of an alternative-SSA request.

max_events_per_replicate.description: Most events per replicate, ≥ 1; a replicate that reaches it stops with `event_limit`.

max_output_bytes.description: Byte budget of the compact result JSON with its trailing newline, also capped at 256 MiB.

max_sampling_steps_per_replicate.description: Includes every random word drawn by every rejection/tail loop. A replicate that exhausts it stops with `sampling_limit` and `CRN-E067`.

threads.description: Worker allowance, 1–1024; at most 64 workers and no more than the replicates are used.

wall_time_s.description: Optional wall-clock limit in seconds, finite and positive, polled cooperatively.

Ensemble.description: Independent replicates of a stochastic run.

replicates.description: Number of independent replicates, ≥ 1, with ids 0 to replicates − 1.

root_seed.description: Root seed. Each replicate draws from its own stream, derived from this seed and the replicate id, so results do not depend on the thread count.

Method.description: Method of an alternative-SSA request, selected by `kind`.

oneOf.description: `ssa`: an exact stochastic simulation algorithm with a waiting-time sampler and policy.

fast.description: Not allowed in ssa-run/0.1; default false in 0.2 and true in 0.3 and 0.4, except for next reaction, which is checked only. Emulates JumpProcesses.jl: Xoshiro256++ words, running totals updated by `+= new - old` without loss or 53-bit resolution checks, and stop polls per batch of events instead of per random word. Selection stays exact for the running totals; paths differ from the checked policy and replay only with the same setting.

ModelRef.description: Reference from a request to its model file: a relative path and the SHA-256 of the exact model bytes.

path.description: Portable, relative to the run file's directory; no parent traversal.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model input bytes, lowercase hexadecimal.

Outputs.description: What a run reports besides the per-replicate accounting; at least one statistic or trajectory.

keep_trajectories.description: How many replicates, starting from id 0, return their saved states; at most `replicates`, and 0 for FSP.

statistics.description: Statistics to compute, each at most once. Stochastic methods report them only when every replicate completed.

RequestVersion.description: Schema tag of an alternative-SSA request; every version is still accepted.

oneOf.description: The first version; `method.fast` is not allowed and the checked policy runs.
Adds the optional `method.fast` switch, default false.
Same fields as 0.2; `method.fast` defaults to true. Set it to false for the checked exact policy.

Same fields and defaults as 0.3, plus the `next_reaction` aggregator. Next reaction supports only the checked policy with inverse waiting times, so its `method.fast` defaults to false and must not be true.

Statistic.description: Ensemble statistic to report per species and save time.

TimeGrid.description: Time horizon and the times at which states are reported, in seconds.

end.description: Horizon in seconds, finite and positive.

save_times.description: Explicit sorted grid including 0 and end; no accumulated step rounding. 2–1000000 strictly increasing values. The state saved at a time includes every event at or before that time.

description: Alternative exact SSA request, bound to one model file by relative path and SHA-256.
